intent: Someone who installs an exported Skill or plugin learns which MCP servers it calls, and a plugin is wired to them, instead of rediscovering what the platform already knows.
observable_outcome: A plugin export declares the listed MCP servers its members call in mcp.json and .mcp.json and names the rest in its README; a single Skill package names the same servers in INSTALL.md.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A plugin whose member declares a listed MCP tool carries mcp.json with that server as streamable-http at its listed address and .mcp.json with it as http.
A declared tool not on the list, a server listed under two addresses, or an address with credentials or a fragment is written into no config and is named for the reader to set up.
A single Skill package's INSTALL.md lists the listed servers its Skill calls and the tools it uses on each.
When the MCP tool list cannot be read, no plugin is built.
